name: kensington-market
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP; app.teleportTo(-1252, -1290, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-1252, 1.7, -1290], look: [-1256, 6, -1420], fov: 60 }); setTimeout(() => console.log("[requests] " + performance.getEntriesByType("resource").map((e) => e.name.replace(location.origin, "").split("?")[0]).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i).sort().join(" ")), 5000); })()
